statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail stays in the low band because the overnight session completed a full 259-point retracement of the Nvidia gap and recovered it, while volatility, yields and index breadth give a one-way path no confirmation. Attention is narrow and centres on the cash open.
recommendation: Conditional attention concentrates in the narrow 13:30-15:30 UTC window covering the U.S. cash open, the first full-liquidity auction to price the overnight Nvidia gap, and the 15:00 UTC Kansas City Fed survey. A second, smaller checkpoint is the 19:00-20:00 UTC closing hour, the last full-liquidity window before Fed Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole keynote on Aug 28 at 14:00 UTC, which falls outside this forecast horizon. Outside those windows the mapped state returns to the calm overnight baseline. Tail remains well below the block threshold. Existing-position management, exits and emergency protection remain unchanged.
headline: Nvidia gap survives a full overnight round trip; NQ futures hold +0.92% into the cash open and Tail stays low at 14
body: Nasdaq-100 futures trade at 29,559.50, up 270.00 points or 0.92% against the 29,289.50 prior settlement, into the 13:30 UTC cash open. The decisive structural evidence is the shape of the overnight session rather than its net change. After reopening on Nvidia's fiscal Q2 2027 beat and its first-ever year-ahead forecast of roughly 70% revenue growth for fiscal 2028, the contract extended to 29,660.50, then retraced 258.75 points to 29,401.75 - giving back the majority of the gap - before recovering to the current level on 137,000 contracts. A retracement of that depth, completed and reversed inside a single overnight session, is direct evidence that mean reversion is functioning rather than failing, which is the condition Tail measures. Price now sits roughly 100 points below the overnight high and 158 above the low, holding neither extreme. Cross-asset confirmation for a persistent one-way path is absent. VIX trades at 15.06, down 0.99%, inside a 14.80-15.10 band with no volatility bid at all. Treasury futures are effectively unchanged across the curve, with 2Y and 10Y constant maturities last published at 4.17% and 4.64% on the Federal Reserve H.15 release. WTI is near $82.49, up 0.43%, and gold is modestly lower. Index internals are unusually dispersed: Nasdaq-100 futures are up 0.84% while Dow futures are down 0.21%, and only three of eight tracked megacaps are higher. Nvidia alone accounts for the advance at roughly +6.5% near $223, with Apple down 1.04% and Microsoft down 0.61%. Semiconductors lead broadly with a group mean near +2.6%, but that leadership is narrow rather than index-wide. Narrow, dispersed leadership of this kind normally preserves internal mean reversion instead of overwhelming it. Second-tier macro landed at 12:30 UTC: initial jobless claims for the week to Aug 22 came in at 203,000 against a 208,000 consensus and a 207,000 prior, a marginally firmer labour reading that drew no visible reaction in rates or volatility. The forward policy backdrop is the main source of elevated Stress. Kansas City Fed President Schmid, host of the symposium, said on the eve of Jackson Hole that inflation remains stubborn and sticky and that the current policy rate is not restrictive, hinting that rates may be too accommodative. Fed Chair Warsh delivers his first Jackson Hole keynote as chair on Aug 28 at 14:00 UTC, alongside Chicago PMI and the preliminary payroll benchmark revision - all outside this 24-hour forecast horizon, so they raise Stress and outcome dispersion inside the window without providing observed path evidence. The dominant mode is assessed as mixed: a directional gap with no directional efficiency, carried by a single name against flat-to-lower breadth.

lookbackSummary: The past 24 hours covered the Nvidia release and its full digestion. From 13:00 UTC on Aug 26 the regime was mixed and calm, with Tail decaying from 15 to 10 through the afternoon while Stress climbed from 52 to 61 as positioning built into the report. The 20:00 UTC release hour moved to WATCH/yellow at Tail 21 and Stress 66, the only non-green hour in the window. Futures reopened at 22:00 UTC on the beat and raised outlook, and the assessment stepped down through 18 and 16 in event/whipsaw mode as the gap held without extending. Through the Asian and European hours the regime returned to mixed at Tail 10-11 with Stress easing to 45-47, the calmest stretch of the window, and the 12:00 UTC hour held Tail 10 into the jobless-claims release. Three hours are unavailable because no assessment was published for them: 21:00 UTC on Aug 26 during the futures maintenance break, and 00:00 and 09:00 UTC on Aug 27. The mapped state was EA_ON/green for every available hour except the release hour.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours are shaped by one checkpoint inside the window and one large catalyst just beyond it. The immediate focus is the 13:30 UTC cash open, where a 0.92% overnight gap meets full liquidity for the first time; conditional Tail sits at 14-15 across the open and first cash hour, then decays toward 11-12 through a midday and afternoon session that carries only a Kansas City Fed survey at 15:00 UTC and a 7-year auction at 17:00 UTC. A modest lift to 14 is carried in the 19:00 UTC closing hour for auction imbalances and position squaring ahead of Friday. Overnight the estimate returns to the 9-11 floor, with the 21:00 UTC maintenance break the structural low, and holds near 11 through Asian hours in normal mode. From the 07:00 UTC European open the path drifts up through 13-15 as the keynote countdown compresses positioning, reaching 16 in the final 12:00 UTC slot. Fed Chair Warsh's first Jackson Hole keynote at 14:00 UTC on Aug 28, Chicago PMI at 13:45 UTC and the preliminary payroll benchmark revision all fall after this window closes, so their weight appears as rising Stress and widening dispersion rather than as an asserted price path. Every hour maps to EA_ON/green; the estimate declines to assert direction ahead of an unprinted release.
